title: what's new in Flat Earth app version 3.0.0
body:
[center][font_size=22]Flat Earth App 3.0.0[/font_size][/center]
[center]
[color=#00af78]What's new in Flat Earth app version 3.0.0[/color] [/center]
[center]{img:p1.webp,size:350}[/center]

[hr][/hr]

[ul]
Stars and constellations.
A new time controller.
Telescope mode for a closer look at the sky.
Labels over solar system objects and stars.
You can use your phone's sensors and gyroscope to find and explore the sky in the new telescope mode using augmented reality.
Support for 10 more languages.
[/ul]

[center]
{img:p2.webp,size:350}
[color=#bababa][font_size=12]Solar eclipse spot visualization[/font_size][/color]
[/center]

[ul]
Solar eclipses are now shown on the Earth map.
New map projections.
[/ul]

[center]
{img:p3.webp,size:350}
[/center]

[ul]
Lunar eclipses can be observed from the menu as well as on map.
Three map options for the map view: Default, Biome and Topographic.
A new wheel time picker, alongside the manual time picker.
[/ul]

[center]
{img:p4.webp,size:350}
[color=#bababa][font_size=12]Icy terrain[/font_size][/color]
[/center]

[center]
{img:p9.webp,size:350}
[color=#bababa][font_size=12]At the sea[/font_size][/color]
[/center]

[ul]
Terrain options for telescope mode.
Search mode for quickly finding a sky object.
 New Astronomical Events Panel.
Graphs for celestial objects that shows horizon events, distance and declination.
[/ul]

[center]
{img:p7.webp,size:350}
[color=#bababa][font_size=12]Jupiter and its four major moons as seen from telescope mode[/font_size][/color]
[/center]

[ul]
Jupiter and Saturn moons have been added and can be observed in telescope mode.
New details for each sky object can be accessed from the top menu.
The navigation tap shows your location and the direction of the tracked object in your local sky.
[/ul]

[center]
{img:p6.webp,size:350}
[color=#bababa][font_size=12]Solar eclipse as seen from telescope mode[/font_size][/color]
[/center]

[ul]
Solar and lunar eclipses can be seen in telescope mode.
Uranus and Neptune have been added.
Options added to better control the zoom level of the camera as well as to change the type of control, map rotation, time or camera position.
Lots of bug fixes and better calculation accuracy. 
[/ul]

[hr][/hr]

[center][font_size=22]A note from the developer[/font_size][/center]

[center]
[color=#00af78]This version of the app was built from the ground up using free and open source tools and frameworks. Because the previous version ran on a limited, closed source engine, I committed a lot of time to recreating the app from scratch with security, transparency and accuracy in mind. This lets me be confident that everything in the app is something I know and control, and it allowed me to add new features that were out of reach before, such as support for many more languages. Visit [url=https://www.oproject.xyz]my website[/url] for more information and ways to download older versions.[/color][/center]
